Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

public class SearchInBST {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        TreeNode root=new TreeNode(4);
        root.left=new TreeNode(2);
        root.right=new TreeNode(7);
        root.left.left=new TreeNode(1);
        root.left.right=new TreeNode(3);
        SearchInBST o=new SearchInBST();
        System.out.println(o.searchBST(root,2));


    }
    public TreeNode searchBST(TreeNode root, int val) {
        while(root!=null && root.data != val){
            if(root.data<val){
                root=root.right;
            }else{
                root=root.left;
            }
        }
        return root;
    }
}
class TreeNode{
    int data;
    TreeNode left,right;
    public TreeNode(int key){
        key=data;
        left=right=null;
    }
}
